description: This source file provides high-level API functions for PHY (Physical Layer) register access specific to the RTL8367C switch on Realtek hardware. It includes functions to set and get PHY and Serdes registers via OCP (Open-core Protocol) and indirect access methods, as well as handling different modes of register access depending on compilation directives.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 ocpData)
methods.description: Sets a PHY OCP register at a specified address for a given PHY port number, with implementation differing based on compile-time macro MDC_MDIO_OPERATION.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Retrieves the value from a PHY OCP register at a specified address for a given PHY port number, with implementation differing based on compile-time macro MDC_MDIO_OPERATION.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 phyData)
methods.description: Sets a PHY register by computing the OCP address and calling rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Gets a PHY register value by computing the OCP address and calling rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 value)
methods.description: Writes to a Serdes register at a specified page and register address.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 * value)
methods.description: Reads from a Serdes register at a specified page and register address, with polling for command completion.
